fichas.title: Group room
fichas.summary: The group room is the main space used by children in a daycare centre. It should offer varied activity zones, potentially including a second level and a play stage with a snug cave. It should be close to the WC area, ideally have direct outdoor access, and face south.

dimensions.label: Required floor area per child
dimensions.context: Approximate required floor area in the group room.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Required floor area approx. 2.5 m2 per child.

dimensions.label: Play deck height threshold
dimensions.context: Play decks up to this height require handrails at least 70 cm high; decks above this height require handrails at least 1.00 m high.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Play decks up to a height of 1.50 m must have a handrail at least 70 em high; play decks more than 1.50 m high must have handrails min. 1.00 m high.

dimensions.label: Handrail height for lower play decks
dimensions.context: Minimum handrail height for play decks up to 1.50 m high.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Play decks up to a height of 1.50 m must have a handrail at least 70 em high;

dimensions.label: Handrail height for higher play decks
dimensions.context: Minimum handrail height for play decks more than 1.50 m high.
dimensions.ocr_raw: play decks more than 1.50 m high must have handrails min. 1.00 m high.

fichas.title: Outdoor areas and pond
fichas.summary: Daycare outdoor areas should offer varied play and landscape experiences. Suggested features include hills, planting, gardens, sandpits, bird tables, dry stone walls, meadows, and a pond. The pond guidance specifies a minimum water surface, depth, and safety measures.
furniture_equipment: Coarse net or builder's steel mesh

dimensions.label: Pond minimum water surface
dimensions.context: Minimum water surface area for a pond in the daycare outdoor area.
dimensions.ocr_raw: Pond should have min. 6 m2 water surface

dimensions.label: Pond depth
dimensions.context: Recommended pond depth; the text says this is to avoid oxygen deficiency.
dimensions.ocr_raw: and a depth of 80 cm to avoid oxygen deficiency.

dimensions.label: Safety mesh depth below water surface
dimensions.context: Builder's steel mesh installation depth below the water surface as a pond safety measure.

fichas.title: Stairs in children's centres
fichas.summary: Stair risers in children's centres should be limited in height, with treads within the stated range.

dimensions.label: Maximum stair riser height
dimensions.context: Stair risers should not exceed this height.
dimensions.ocr_raw: The risers of stairs in children's centres should not be more than 16 em,

dimensions.label: Stair tread depth
dimensions.ocr_raw: and the treads between 30 and 32 em.

fichas.title: Rest, kitchen, and dining spaces
fichas.summary: Rest rooms are optional where mattresses can be laid out in the group room for midday sleep. Kitchen arrangements may be centralized or distributed among group rooms; different floor heights are recommended to support adults and children cooking together. The group room is normally used for meals, although an extended corridor or entrance hall may also serve as a communal eating place.
